top_signals.title: Gold Steadies Below $4,300 as Markets Await Fed Rate Decision
top_signals.summary: Gold was steady as high oil prices continued to fuel inflation concerns and keep interest-rate hike bets a near-certainty ahead of the Federal Reserve’s policy decision later Wednesday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Steady as Traders Await Fed Decision: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks were broadly steady as elevated oil prices and rising bond yields kept investors cautious ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision.

top_signals.title: House to vote on bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
top_signals.summary: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Apollo Gives $585 Million of Financing to The Executive Centre
top_signals.summary: Apollo Global Management has provided $585 million of financing to flexible workspace provider The Executive Centre, according to a statement, in the global asset manager’s largest Asian hybrid deal combining debt and equity.
